summary: One church with a perpetual Adoration chapel in the on-campus Parish Center (recorded 24/7 at the church, R38). Mass and Confession times agree in both issues read (Nov 8 and Nov 15); the bulletin's confession end times (4:50, 6:50) differ slightly from the website's (4:45, 6:45) and the bulletin is followed. Open: whether to add the Dec 7-8 Immaculate Conception holy-day Masses from the standing holy-day schedule.

sources.said: EXPOSITION AND ADORATION OF THE BLESSED SACRAMENT Perpetual (24 hours a day, 7 days a week) in the Blessed Sacrament Chapel located in the Parish Center.
Our parish offers Exposition of the Blessed Sacrament 24 hours a day, 7 days a week (except during inclement weather) in our Eucharistic Adoration Chapel located in the Parish Center.
Perpetual (24 hours a day, 7 days a week) in the Blessed Sacrament Chapel located in the Parish Center.
Parish Center - Offices & Meeting Rooms (Mailing Address) 50 Van Winkle Place, Piscataway, NJ 08854

slots.rationale: R1, R38: the parish names exposition 24/7 in its chapel in the Parish Center. The Parish Center (50 Van Winkle Place) is on the church's campus: it geocodes (OpenStreetMap) about 120 m from the church's point in data/churches.csv, and the bulletin's room legend treats it as one campus with the church and Rec Center (499 New Market Rd). Seven daily slots 00:00-23:59, as other perpetual chapels are recorded.
